name: Android Compose Starter
description: Jetpack Compose skeleton with Retrofit, Room, WorkManager offline queue and encrypted prefs. No domain code.
notableFeatures: Offline queue with a permanent vs transient HTTP error split (401/403/422 never retried) and an attempt cap.
Hand-rolled composition root, Keystore-encrypted prefs for the auth header, and BASIC-only OkHttp logging.
Shared composables, connectivity banner and ktlint in CI.

name: Dotnet Minimal API Starter
description: .NET 10 minimal API on MongoDB with JWT auth, Testcontainers tests and CI. Tenancy and worker host are optional.
notableFeatures: Startup guard refuses the dev placeholder JWT secret in Production; login is rate limited and uses one error for unknown user and wrong password.
Query-building logic is internal and unit-testable as BsonDocument construction without a database.
Optional tenancy and background worker folders, with Dockerfiles for the API and the worker.

name: iOS SwiftUI Starter
description: SwiftUI skeleton with XcodeGen, GraphQL over HTTP and WebSocket, Keychain, APNs and deep links. No dependencies.
notableFeatures: GraphQL client and graphql-transport-ws subscription client on URLSession with no third-party Swift dependencies.
Keychain token storage, sign-in and register, and APNs registration with permission problems surfaced to the user.
Deep-link coordinator for push taps in all app states; project generated from project.yml and CI runs on macOS.

name: Spring Angular Starter
description: Spring Boot 4 API and Angular frontend with JWT, refresh tokens, optional OIDC, Flyway, and security CI.
notableFeatures: JWT access tokens plus revocable refresh tokens, optional OIDC SSO with Keycloak for local development.
Shared Angular UI component set with server-side field errors, and a rename.sh that swaps placeholders then deletes itself.
CI with secret scanning, CodeQL and dependency scanning; Spotless formatting enforced.

name: Expo Router Starter
description: Expo SDK 58 starter with cookie-session login, push registration, deep linking and a Jest test setup.
notableFeatures: Auth state machine (bootstrapping, needs-server, signed-out, signed-in) with a user-supplied server URL.
Native FCM/APNs token registration on sign-in and tap-to-navigate for pushes carrying an in-app route.
CI also runs expo export for both platforms and an npm audit script with a dated allowlist.

name: FastAPI Next.js Starter
description: FastAPI and Next.js 16 starter with auth, one JSON error contract, rate limiting, Docker and CI.
notableFeatures: Single error contract for every failure, with per-field validation errors keyed by name; pagination helper that rejects bad values.
Constant-work login against a dummy hash, Redis-backed login and register rate limits, and a two-role Postgres setup.
Browser never calls the backend directly: Next.js route handlers proxy using the session cookie.

name: Go Gin SvelteKit Starter
description: Go (Gin) and SvelteKit starter with operator login, JSON error contract, rate limiting, Docker and CI.
notableFeatures: HMAC-signed session cookie auth, CSRF-style JSON content-type check and per-email and per-IP login limiter.
Pagination helper, agent credential helper and golang-migrate migrations; tests run with a real Postgres.
Optional Kubernetes, Terraform and Lambda example folders, plus Svelte 5 runes and Vitest component tests.

name: Flutter Starter
description: Flutter skeleton with API client, secure storage, local reminders, Material 3 theme and shared widgets.
notableFeatures: Typed ApiException client, Keychain/Keystore token storage and build-time config through --dart-define.
Fake secure storage and fake reminder scheduler for plain flutter_test runs.
Emulator checks: reminder delivery test and a reboot-survival script using a probe APK; CI runs analyze and format.

name: Laravel API Nuxt Starter
description: Laravel 13 API with a Nuxt 4 frontend: Sanctum cookie auth, error contract, Postgres roles, Pest, Playwright.
notableFeatures: Sanctum SPA cookie auth with explicit-origin CORS and a runtime/migrator Postgres role split.
Optional multi-tenancy module with Row-Level Security and an optional RabbitMQ queue module with delayed delivery.
Pest, Larastan level 8, Vitest and Playwright specs against the real API, with security scanning in CI.

name: Laravel Inertia Vue Starter
description: Laravel 12, Inertia, Vue 3 and Tailwind starter with session auth, error contract, widget build and CI.
notableFeatures: Rate-limited login with session regeneration and exponential lockout; one JSON error contract and Inertia error pages.
Separate Vite build for a standalone embeddable widget that imports no Inertia or Laravel assets.
Runtime/migrator Postgres roles, dev and production Docker, Larastan level 8 and Vitest.

name: Laravel Package Starter
description: Laravel package skeleton with provider, publishable config and migration, facade, Artisan command and CI matrix.
notableFeatures: Depends on individual illuminate components and CI tests every supported PHP and Laravel combination.
Uses publishesMigrations(), a rebindable repository contract and an install command; composer.lock is intentionally not committed.
composer check runs Pint, Larastan and Pest; rename.sh swaps the placeholders.

name: Node GraphQL Starter
description: Express 5, Apollo Server 5, graphql-ws subscriptions, Prisma 7 on PostgreSQL and JWT auth.
notableFeatures: Zod-validated environment, Helmet, rate-limited /graphql, and a WebSocket upgrade rate limiter with a connection cap.
WebSocket server built with noServer and a manual upgrade handler to avoid a shutdown double-close.
Multi-stage non-root Dockerfile, CI with CodeQL and security scans, and tests against a real PostgreSQL.
